title: MongoDB reads wait on connection capacity
description: Database read latency is elevated. Mongo queries wait up to 4 seconds for a connection pool slot. Slow query logs show a collection scan and missing index on the product lookup. Replication lag is stable.

analysis.summary: Signals most closely match database. Start with ‘Trace the database bottleneck’.
analysis.recommendation: Capture the offending query or partition key. Propose an index or capacity change using the evidence; do not restart the database as a first step.
checks: Separate connection wait time from query execution time.
Inspect slow query plans, index coverage and hot partitions.
Check primary health and replication lag before changing read preferences.
